description: This file contains unit tests for the Parser class handling WindowManagerState traces, verifying timestamp parsing, trace type, and trace entries.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the parser instance asynchronously before tests run.

methods.name: it('has expected trace type')
methods.description: Checks that the parser correctly identifies the trace type as WINDOW_MANAGER.

methods.name: it('provides elapsed timestamps')
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly retrieves elapsed timestamps.

methods.name: it('provides real timestamps')
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly retrieves real timestamps.

methods.name: it('retrieves trace entry')
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a trace entry and its timestamp accuracy.

methods.name: it('formats entry timestamps')
methods.description: Checks that the timestamp formatting of entries works as expected.
